      void act()

      • bounceRight

        public void bounceRight(int paddleY,
                        int paddleHeight,
                        Paddle.PaddleState paddleState)
        Bounces the ball off the left paddle, sending it to the right and increasing its speed each time hit, x speed is clamped
        Parameters:
        paddleY - the y coordinate of the top of the paddle that was hit
        paddleHeight - the height of the paddle that was hit in pixels
        paddleState - whether the paddle was idle, moving up or moving down when it hit
